units.source_text: 我看见一块块的云朵掠过月前，

en.t: I saw one cloud after another sweep across the face of the moon,

units.source_text: 宛如千军万马似地从群山那边由南而北压将过来。

en.t: as if a vast army of men and horses were pressing down from beyond the mountains, moving from south to north.

units.source_text: 有厚厚的云层，也有薄薄的云彩。

en.t: There were thick layers of cloud, and there were also thin wisps of cloud.

units.source_text: 有长长的大片，也有孤零的断片。

en.t: There were long, broad masses, and there were lonely broken fragments.

units.source_text: 所有的一块块云朵都是从天的南边呈现，从月前掠过，

en.t: Every single cloud appeared from the southern edge of the sky and swept past the moon,

units.source_text: 笼罩着金阁的房顶，仿佛急于去办什么大事似的，朝北奔去。

en.t: covering the roof of the Golden Pavilion, then hurrying north as though eager to attend to some great matter.

units.source_text: 我仿佛听见头上的金凤凰的啼鸣声。

en.t: I seemed to hear the cry of the golden phoenix above my head.
